Cave specimens.

method: species description from type material and field observation
conditions: Species-wide statement in the 'Troglomorphic characters' paragraph for the cave fish from Khe Lanh Cave, Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park, Quang Binh, Vietnam; sexes not given. Holotype IEBR 105901 (74.3 mm SL) and 13 paratypes (IHB 2016105895-9, IEBR 105900-04, VU 5905-08), all with the holotype's data (12 August 2011, A. T. Ho and N. T. The Description says 'Eye relatively small, positioned laterodorsally in anterior half of head' with diameter less than maxillary-barbel length, the Diagnosis gives 'smaller (vs. larger) eyes' against congeners, and the same paragraph adds 'reduced eye size' as a troglomorphic character. Table 1 lists eye diameter as % of head length (holotype 17.7; paratypes 10.9-17.7; mean 13.6).
